description: Coarse diff regions for a step, clustered from raw pixel-level differences. Each region includes a diffCount. Already reflects any match regions added during resolution — a masked area no longer shows up here. Run this before fetching any images or DOM data for a step. Resolution can happen between calls, so never reuse an earlier result in this conversation — call it again. A low-level primitive: for a driven step-level review, call eyes_review_progress with scope: "step" instead — it calls this internally for every changed area.

rect.description: Optional crop/filter rectangle in pixels. Use image sizes from eyes_inspect_steps to construct it (e.g. top quarter of a 1020×600 image = {left:0,top:0,width:1020,height:150}).

sessionUrl.description: Eyes session URL: https://eyes.applitools.com/app/test-results/{batchId}/{sessionId}[/steps/{N}]?accountId=... (the /steps/N suffix is ignored if present)

stepIndex.description: Zero-based index of the step, as returned by eyes_inspect_steps

workspaceRoot.description: Root directory of the caller's project (optional; used to locate its .env credentials)

name: eyes_inspect_changed_areas
